pairs.name: ntsc against whole
pairs.problem: Frame rates do not match (24.000 vs 23.976 fps).

pairs.name: variable
pairs.problem: Variable-frame-rate video is not supported safely yet. Convert both videos to the same constant frame rate before comparing them.

pairs.name: durations
pairs.problem: Durations do not match (60.000 vs 30.000 seconds). Set a duration limit within both files if comparing only their common opening segment.

pairs.name: limit past the end
pairs.problem: The duration limit extends beyond the end of one of the videos.

pairs.name: raw stream
pairs.problem: raw.hevc is a raw HEVC stream with no timestamps, so its frame rate is unknown. Put it in a container with its frame rate first, e.g. mkvmerge -o video.mkv --default-duration 0:120fps <file> (MKVToolNix), with the video's own frame rate.

pairs.name: raw h264
pairs.problem: c.264 is a raw H.264 stream with no timestamps, so its frame rate is unknown. Put it in a container with its frame rate first, e.g. mkvmerge -o video.mkv --default-duration 0:120fps <file> (MKVToolNix), with the video's own frame rate.
